# BotDrop

> BotDrop sells self-hosted Discord and Steam bot templates as Python source code you own, rebrand and ship. Each is unit-tested, its data fetchers are live-tested against real public APIs, it needs no paid API keys (Discord bots need a free bot token), and it ships with a Dockerfile (built and run in QA) plus Render/Railway/Procfile configs. Untested parts are labelled beta.

Status: live. Buy via Gumroad (USD). Site: https://getbotdrop.com/ · X: https://x.com/getbotdrop · Free MIT notifier: https://github.com/botdrop-gg/free-games-notifier-lite

## Bundle
- BotDrop Bundle: all 10 templates incl. the Community Kit and Stream Alert Bot. $29. Products sold separately add up to $119. Buy: https://gklab.gumroad.com/l/gtnidl

## Refund policy
30-day refund if the template doesn't work for you. Request it through Gumroad. Policy: https://getbotdrop.com/refunds/ · Terms: https://getbotdrop.com/terms/

## Steam data
Some features use public, undocumented Steam store endpoints and page data, not the official Steam Web API. Valve may change or limit them at any time. Keep polling intervals reasonable; you are responsible for complying with Steam's terms.

## Trademarks
BotDrop is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Valve, Epic Games, GOG, GitHub, Google/YouTube, Twitch or Discord. Steam is a trademark of Valve Corporation.

## FAQ
- Q: Do I get the full source code? A: Yes. Every BotDrop product is a zip of readable Python source code with tests, a setup guide, a Dockerfile and Render/Railway/Procfile deploy configs. You host it yourself.
- Q: Can I rebrand it or use it for clients? A: Yes. The commercial license lets you use, modify and rebrand the bots for your own projects and client projects, including bots you run for others. You may not resell or redistribute the template itself as a template or kit.
- Q: Do I need paid API keys? A: No. The bots use public Steam, Epic and GitHub endpoints (some Steam features use public, undocumented Steam store endpoints, not the official Steam Web API; see the Terms). Discord bots need a free Discord bot token. Review Verdict for Steam can optionally use a free local Ollama model (beta) or your own LLM key.
- Q: What is tested? A: Every product has unit tests and its data fetchers were run against the real public APIs. Every Docker image was built and run. Anything not live-tested, like the AI rewrite, the Twitch API path or Render/Railway deploys, is labelled beta.
- Q: What's in the bundle? A: All 10 products, including the Gaming Community Kit for Discord and Stream Alert Bot, for $29. The products sold separately add up to $119.
- Q: What if it doesn't work for me? A: 30-day refund if the template doesn't work for you. Request it through Gumroad. Details: https://getbotdrop.com/refunds/
